items.desc: The affordable newsletter for the agentic era. Open source: self-host it, or use mailcheap.ai.

A local AI engine and server for one NVIDIA DGX Spark. It serves Qwen3.8-27B and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next with its own NVFP4 and EXL3 kernels, draft trees sized by StairCut, and caches that survive a restart. OpenAI-compatible API, chat, dashboard and a setup guide.
